deep_research.name: LiteLLM
deep_research.license: MIT (verify current repository LICENSE before copying code)
deep_research.stack: Python proxy/router with Rust-supported components and provider integrations
deep_research.adoptable: provider capability matrix, normalized error taxonomy, router policy contract, provider compatibility tests
deep_research.ui_or_ops: operational metrics and configuration-oriented admin surfaces
deep_research.adaptation: medium; preserve Sub3API Go service/repository boundaries and port only contracts/policies
deep_research.decision: adopt concepts, not a wholesale port

deep_research.name: New API
deep_research.stack: Go backend with web frontend, relay/model/router/plugin layers
deep_research.adoptable: provider health and channel diagnostics, compatibility test fixtures, clearer relay capability metadata
deep_research.adaptation: low-to-medium for concepts; high for code due license and differing domain model
deep_research.decision: reference behavior only; do not copy code

deep_research.name: One API
deep_research.adoptable: small compatibility fixtures and simplified user-facing setup flows
deep_research.ui_or_ops: simple navigation and low-friction key/channel operations
deep_research.adaptation: medium; existing Sub3API already exceeds the scope, so only isolated UX patterns are useful
deep_research.decision: use as baseline comparison, not as architecture target

deep_research.name: Portkey Gateway
deep_research.stack: TypeScript gateway with provider adapters, plugins and deployment configuration
deep_research.adoptable: explicit adapter interface, request policy hooks, provider-specific capability declarations
deep_research.adaptation: medium-to-high; translate TypeScript middleware ideas to Go interfaces

deep_research.name: Bifrost
deep_research.stack: Go AI gateway focused on throughput, provider routing and operational simplicity
deep_research.adoptable: benchmarks for gateway hot paths, explicit timeout/retry budgets, provider health snapshots
deep_research.ui_or_ops: minimal operational surface with performance signals
deep_research.adaptation: medium; benchmark before changing existing Sub3API paths
deep_research.decision: use for performance comparison and targeted experiments

research_limitations: Live GitHub star counts and push timestamps were not used as quality scores.
No source code or assets were copied; every license must be rechecked before implementation reuse.
Browser-level UI comparison and production performance benchmarks were not run in this environment.
